_doc: Security patterns of the SOURCE app, reported in the Vision 'Security' line — never blocking, never copied as-is to the target (the plan's changes fix them). Regexes run on committed code files; `absent_in_file`: flag only when the file has no such call; `group_name`: capture group named in the message.

patterns.message: upload-token route without authentication: anyone can obtain an upload token (anonymous uploads)
authentication left as a TODO by the template

compares a header with `Bearer ${process.env.%s}`: if the variable is unset, 'Bearer undefined' is accepted — refuse when it is missing, and compare in constant time (crypto.timingSafeEqual), never with !==
files served with a Content-Type taken from upload metadata (client-chosen): once files share the app's origin, serve with nosniff + CSP sandbox, inline only png/jpeg/webp/gif
content type checked only against what the client declares (allowedContentTypes): verify the bytes server-side
